name: Mitoyo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mitoyo city emblem in light blue and green: a light blue stylised wave above green horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Mitoyo, a city in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 8 October 2008; the emblem dates from 1 January 2006.

features.role: Mitoyo city emblem — a light blue stylised wave above green horizontal strokes
